text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
TANKERS - Iron Gippsland - (built 1989) 87,241 dwt sold to Singaporean buyers for $28.5 million with subjects outstanding.
CONTAINERS - Oocl Honour - (built 1989) 46,100 dwt plus sistership:
Oocl Hope - (built 1989) 45,750 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $35 million each including twelve to eighteen months timecharter back at $27,500 per day.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
